schema.description: The ShiftPlan key is the canonical `siteCode`; `buildingId` is its DEPRECATED alias (same value, same stored column; ADR 0035). Send at least one. Sending both with the same value is fine; both with different values is rejected with 422 conflicting-site-and-building.

siteCode.description: The canonical Site code (the facility-layout Site code, e.g. WH1) the plan is for. Required unless the deprecated buildingId is sent.

buildingId.description: DEPRECATED -- use siteCode. Alias of siteCode with the same value. Required only when siteCode is not sent.

lines.description: One or more path plan lines. Must contain at least one line (shift-plan-no-path-plans if empty).

plannedHours.description: Total committed hours for this path. Must not exceed plannedHeads * the configured max hours per shift.

installedStations.description: Physical stations installed on this path, supplied by the caller (this context has no dependency on Work Planning, which owns this number). plannedHeads must not exceed this.

schema.title: CommitShiftPlanRequest
